en.review.wiz.wiz.is.the.fastest-growing.cl: Wiz is the fastest-growing cloud security company in history, revolutionizing how organizations secure their cloud environments. Its agentless architecture provides complete visibility across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes without deploying any software.
The platform's Security Graph technology connects the dots between vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, identities, and exposed data to identify toxic risk combinations that actually matter. AI-powered prioritization helps teams focus on the issues that pose real risk.
en.review.wiz.wiz.has.become.the.go-to: Wiz has become the go-to choice for cloud-first organizations looking for comprehensive security without the operational overhead of agent-based solutions.

en.review.wiz.ai-driven.prioritization.focu: AI-driven prioritization focuses on toxic combinations and actual attack paths.
Automated compliance mapping for SOC2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and more.

pt.review.wiz.wiz.is.the.fastest-growing.cl: Wiz é a empresa de segurança na nuvem com crescimento mais rápido da história, revolucionando a forma como as organizações protegem seus ambientes em nuvem. Sua arquitetura sem agentes fornece visibilidade completa em AWS, Azure, GCP e Kubernetes sem implantar nenhum software.
A tecnologia Security Graph da plataforma conecta os pontos entre vulnerabilidades, configurações incorretas, identidades e dados expostos para identificar combinações de risco tóxico que realmente importam. A priorização com IA ajuda as equipes a se concentrarem nos problemas que apresentam risco real.
